summary: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of a $100 million private placement of convertible notes on September 7, 2026. The notes bear 3.75% annual interest, convertible at $16.00 per ordinary share, maturing September 1, 2031. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes including satellite technology investments. The offering was made only in Israel under Regulation S, not to U.S. persons. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from conversion and interest step-up conditions.
